convert_dataset_cli: convert an image dataset folder or archive into a StyleGAN2 ADA PyTorch compatible dataset archive
open_dataset: open and iterate images from a folder, zip, lmdb, hdf5, cifar10, or mnist source
make_transform: create a crop and resize transform function for center-crop or center-crop-wide image processing
open_image_folder: open a directory of images and iterate them with optional labels from dataset.json
open_dest: open a destination path as a zip archive or folder for writing converted dataset images
